title: MLGym: A New Framework and Benchmark for Advancing AI Research Agents
authors_zh: Deepak Nathani、Lovish Madaan、Nicholas Roberts、Nikolay Bashlykov、Ajay Menon、Vincent Moens、Mikhail Plekhanov、Amar Budhiraja、Despoina Magka、Vladislav Vorotilov、Gaurav Chaurasia、Dieuwke Hupkes、Ricardo Silveira Cabral、Tatiana Shavrina、Jakob Nicolaus Foerster、Yoram Bachrach、William Yang Wang、Roberta Raileanu
paper_type_zh: AI 研究智能体环境、评测基准与轨迹发布论文
best_for_zh: 研究环境交互轨迹、科学智能体评测、程序化 evaluator、失败样本保留、replay 与数据发布审计的读者
one_line: MLGym releases 13 containerized ML-research tasks and a current 676-run action/observation corpus with task-specific evaluator scores and replay code, but repeated validation exposes test feedback, native Gym reward remains zero, and the release is untagged and license-mixed.
MLGym 将 13 个容器化 ML 研究任务表示为 thought/action/observation/state 与 evaluator score 轨迹；论文分析 624 条运行，而当前仓库为 676 对轨迹/结果文件，但无限 test-set validate、恒为 0 的 Gym reward、可变 latest 镜像与混合许可限制其复用。
why: It connects task/data configuration, container state, one-command agent actions, observations, intermediate evaluator feedback, flexible research artifacts, failures, and replay into one auditable episode object, while showing why a Gym interface and public trajectories do not by themselves establish a clean RL reward, held-out evaluation, deterministic replay, or training-safe release.
inclusion_reason: MLGym makes an AI-research episode inspectable as task configuration, container state, shell/tool trace, repeated validation feedback, flexible submitted artifact, evaluator metrics, and exit status. It is a core Track 6 environment and trajectory release, while its visible test feedback, zero native Gym reward, mutable release boundary, and mixed upstream rights are equally important for deciding whether the episodes can be reused beyond evaluation and audit.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The canonical paper source is the final COLM 2025 paper, not arXiv v1 or the mutable repository alone. It introduces MLGym as a Gymnasium-style shell environment and MLGym-Bench as 13 open-ended Level-1 baseline-improvement tasks spanning data science, game theory, computer vision, NLP, and reinforcement learning. The final author list has 18 authors, including Mikhail Plekhanov, who is absent from arXiv v1.

The concrete problem is how to evaluate AI-research agents that must inspect data, modify code, train models, and submit heterogeneous artifacts under resource limits. A universal answer string is insufficient: task outputs may be CSV predictions, model weights or policies, Python strategy code, or optimized training/heuristic code. Each task therefore binds a natural-language description, datasets, optional starter code, dependencies, evaluator, baseline score, timeout, and expected artifact to a containerized workspace.

For the atlas, the central object is an executed environment episode. A released .traj record contains environment, trajectory, history, and info. Steps include action, observation, response, state, thought, and execution_time; info carries cost/token/API statistics, exit status, submission, score history, and summarizer data. The object connects prompt, shell/tool behavior, observable feedback, workspace state, flexible output, verifier scores, termination, and provenance, placing it directly in environment_agent_trajectory_data.

The final paper's failure analysis covers 13 tasks × 12 models × 4 seeds = 624 trajectories. At the audited repository commit, current public main contains 676 .traj files and 676 paired results.json files across 13 model-directory names × 13 tasks × 4 runs. The extra gemini-20-pro grid postdates the final-paper comparison and is repository-release evidence only; it must not be attributed to the paper's results.

The inclusion boundary is evaluation, audit, environment design, and trajectory-release analysis. The paper presents the environment as future training infrastructure but does not demonstrate an agent-policy training run. Current MLGymEnv.step returns native Gym reward 0 while task metrics live in info.score, so the release is not evidence of an off-the-shelf RL reward contract.

规范论文来源是 COLM 2025 最终版，而不是 arXiv v1 或单独的可变仓库。论文将 MLGym 定义为 Gymnasium 风格 shell 环境，将 MLGym-Bench 定义为 13 个开放式 Level-1 baseline-improvement 任务，覆盖 data science、game theory、computer vision、NLP 与 reinforcement learning。最终作者列表有 18 人，其中包括 arXiv v1 未列出的 Mikhail Plekhanov。

具体问题是如何评测需要检查数据、修改代码、训练模型并在资源限制内提交异构 artifact 的 AI 研究 agent。统一答案字符串不足以表达任务输出；结果可能是 CSV prediction、模型 weight 或 policy、Python strategy code，或优化后的 training/heuristic code。因此，每个任务都把自然语言描述、dataset、可选 starter code、dependency、evaluator、baseline score、timeout 与预期 artifact 绑定到容器化 workspace。

对 Atlas 而言，核心对象是一条已执行的环境 episode。公开 .traj record 包含 environment、trajectory、history 与 info。step 字段包括 action、observation、response、state、thought 和 execution_time；info 保存 cost/token/API 统计、exit status、submission、score history 与 summarizer 数据。该对象连接 prompt、shell/tool 行为、可见反馈、workspace state、灵活输出、verifier score、终止与 provenance，因此直接属于 environment_agent_trajectory_data。

最终论文的 failure analysis 覆盖 13 个任务 × 12 个模型 × 4 个 seed = 624 条 trajectory。审计 commit 下的当前 public main 包含 676 个 .traj 文件和 676 个配对 results.json 文件，对应 13 个 model-directory name × 13 个任务 × 4 次运行。额外的 gemini-20-pro 网格晚于最终论文比较，只能作为仓库发布证据，不能归入论文结果。

收录边界是 evaluation、audit、环境设计与 trajectory-release 分析。论文把该环境描述为未来训练基础设施，但没有展示 agent-policy training run。当前 MLGymEnv.step 返回的原生 Gym reward 恒为 0，任务 metric 位于 info.score，因此该发布不是可直接使用的 RL reward contract 证据。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
MLGym's core idea is to turn heterogeneous ML experimentation into a common container-and-command interface while leaving task-specific scoring to programmatic evaluators. An agent receives task and dataset instructions, optional starter artifacts, prior message history, and tool documentation; at each step it emits one shell or tool command and observes the textual result plus workspace state.

The action space includes non-interactive Bash; open, scroll, search, find, create, edit, and insert operations; validate; and terminal submit. Optional modules add literature search/PDF parsing and memory operations, but they are not all part of the reported paper comparison. A task-specific Python evaluator reads the flexible artifact and emits metrics such as accuracy, validation loss, R2, BLEU, game or RL return, or wall-clock time. No learned judge is used.

The decisive feedback contract is unusual for a benchmark. validate calls the scoring surface, returns the current test-set score, and does not terminate, so an agent may adapt repeatedly to visible test feedback. submit invokes scoring and terminates. Step or USD budget exhaustion can trigger autosubmission of the latest codebase when possible. A run is valid if at least one evaluator score exists; validity does not mean it beats the baseline or constitutes scientific novelty.

The public environment's native Gym transition reward is always 0. Task metrics are appended to info.score, and cross-task comparisons later transform metric direction into performance profiles and area under the profile (AUP). Treating info.score as an RL reward would require an explicit adapter and objective that the paper does not implement. The demonstrated supervision is evaluator feedback attached to steps and full episodes for evaluation and audit.

Relative to benchmark suites that expose only prompts and final scores, MLGym releases task configuration, execution traces, intermediate validation history, flexible submissions, failure states, and replay code in one environment abstraction. Relative to MLE-Bench, MLAgentBench, RE-Bench, ScienceAgentBench, and SWE-Agent, its claimed scope is 13 Level-1 research tasks under a uniform command loop. It does not demonstrate autonomous scientific discovery or policy training.

MLGym 的核心思路是把异构 ML 实验转化为统一的 container-and-command 接口，同时让任务专属程序化 evaluator 负责评分。agent 接收 task/dataset instruction、可选 starter artifact、历史 message 与 tool documentation；每个 step 只输出一条 shell 或 tool command，并观察文本结果与 workspace state。

action space 包括非交互 Bash，open、scroll、search、find、create、edit、insert 操作，validate 与终局 submit。可选模块还提供 literature search/PDF parsing 与 memory 操作，但这些模块并非都用于论文报告的比较。任务专属 Python evaluator 读取灵活 artifact，并输出 accuracy、validation loss、R2、BLEU、game/RL return 或 wall-clock time 等 metric。系统不使用 learned judge。

该 benchmark 最关键的 feedback contract 不同于一次性评测。validate 调用评分面、返回当前 test-set score 且不终止，因此 agent 可以反复根据可见 test feedback 调整。submit 评分后终止。达到 step 或 USD budget 时，在可行情况下会自动提交最新 codebase。只要至少产生一个 evaluator score，该运行就算 valid；valid 不等于超过 baseline，也不代表具备科学新意。

公开环境的原生 Gym transition reward 恒为 0。任务 metric 被追加到 info.score，跨任务比较随后把 metric 方向转换为 performance profile 与 area under the profile（AUP）。若要把 info.score 当作 RL reward，需要论文并未实现的显式 adapter 与 objective。已展示的 supervision 是附着在 step 与 full episode 上、用于 evaluation 和 audit 的 evaluator feedback。

相较只提供 prompt 与最终 score 的 benchmark suite，MLGym 在同一环境抽象中发布 task config、execution trace、中间 validation history、灵活 submission、failure state 与 replay code。相较 MLE-Bench、MLAgentBench、RE-Bench、ScienceAgentBench 和 SWE-Agent，其报告范围是统一 command loop 下的 13 个 Level-1 研究任务。论文没有展示 autonomous scientific discovery 或 policy training。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs are 13 author-curated tasks and their public datasets or environments. Task YAML binds task and dataset descriptions, dataset configuration, task entry point, starter/submission instructions, baseline paths and scores, evaluator paths and a read-only flag, dependencies, training-command timeout, and optional memory path. No task-candidate pool or rejection ledger is released.

At reset, MLGym launches a Docker or Podman environment with a non-root /home/agent/workspace, installs or exposes task dependencies, datasets, starter code, evaluator, GPU allocation, and the SWE-Agent-derived Agent-Computer Interface. The paper-run image digest manifest is unavailable; current documentation defaults to aigym/mlgym-agent:latest.

The scaffold composes the task/dataset prompt and ACI documentation, then runs a single-command ReAct loop. Each model generates discussion/thought and a parsed shell/tool action. The environment executes it and returns command output, current step/remaining-step counters, open-file and working-directory state, and—after validate—the evaluator score. The trajectory records action, observation, response, state, thought, and execution time together with role-tagged history and run-level info.

Paper experiments evaluate 12 models with 4 seeds for every task. Configurable models use temperature 0.0 and top-p 0.95; o1-preview and o3-mini use their API default temperature 1.0. Each run stops after 50 environment interactions or USD 4 API cost, whichever arrives first, with additional task-specific training timeouts. The paper reports Best Attempt over valid intermediate validate calls, Best Submission over final submissions across the 4 runs, and cross-task performance profile/AUP.

Task-specific Python evaluators score submissions. validate exposes the same test-set surface without terminating; submit scores and ends the episode. Exit paths also include budget autosubmission, skip/forfeit, format, runtime, cost, context, permission, and environment errors. The repository retains both valid and invalid current-grid runs rather than filtering to successes.

Outputs are task artifacts, .traj episodes, paired results.json, intermediate score histories, final metric dictionaries, exit status, and aggregate results. run_replay.py extracts recorded assistant message contents as actions, writes replay JSONL, and invokes the runner with model_name=replay. Deterministic replay still requires pinned task/data/evaluator/dependency versions, immutable image digests, hardware/runtime details, seeds, and environment reset state.

输入是 13 个作者策划任务及其公开 dataset 或 environment。Task YAML 绑定 task/dataset description、dataset config、task entrypoint、starter/submission instruction、baseline path 与 score、evaluator path 与 read-only flag、dependency、training-command timeout 和可选 memory path。论文没有发布 task candidate pool 或 rejection ledger。

reset 时，MLGym 启动 Docker 或 Podman 环境，提供非 root 的 /home/agent/workspace，安装或挂载任务 dependency、dataset、starter code、evaluator、GPU allocation 与基于 SWE-Agent 的 Agent-Computer Interface。论文运行所用 image digest manifest 不可获得；当前文档默认使用 aigym/mlgym-agent:latest。

scaffold 组合 task/dataset prompt 与 ACI documentation，再执行 single-command ReAct loop。每个模型生成 discussion/thought 和一条解析后的 shell/tool action。环境执行动作并返回 command output、当前 step/剩余 step 计数、open-file/working-directory state，以及调用 validate 后的 evaluator score。trajectory 记录 action、observation、response、state、thought、execution time、role-tagged history 与 run-level info。

论文实验在每个任务上评测 12 个模型，每个模型使用 4 个 seed。可配置模型使用 temperature 0.0、top-p 0.95；o1-preview 与 o3-mini 使用其 API 默认 temperature 1.0。每次运行在 50 次环境交互或 USD 4 API cost 时停止，以先到者为准；另有任务专属训练 timeout。论文报告所有有效中间 validate 中的 Best Attempt、4 次运行最终 submission 中的 Best Submission，以及跨任务 performance profile/AUP。

任务专属 Python evaluator 为 submission 评分。validate 暴露同一 test-set surface 但不终止；submit 评分并结束 episode。其他退出路径包括预算 autosubmission、skip/forfeit，以及 format、runtime、cost、context、permission 与 environment error。仓库保留当前网格中的 valid 和 invalid run，而不是只筛成功样本。

输出包括任务 artifact、.traj episode、配对 results.json、中间 score history、最终 metric dictionary、exit status 与 aggregate result。run_replay.py 抽取记录中的 assistant message content 作为 action，写入 replay JSONL，并以 model_name=replay 调用 runner。确定性 replay 仍需要固定 task/data/evaluator/dependency 版本、不可变 image digest、hardware/runtime 细节、seed 与环境 reset state。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The final paper evaluates 12 models on 13 tasks with 4 runs per model-task pair and analyzes all 624 trajectories for failure behavior. Under its aggregate AUP comparison, Gemini-2.5-Pro ranks highest. Every model except o1-preview, Gemini-1.5-Pro, and Gemini-2.0-Flash fails to produce a valid submission on at least 1 task. These are author-reported benchmark results, not independently reproduced findings.

The failure evidence is richer than a leaderboard score. The paper distinguishes failure—no valid intermediate test-set score—from incompletion—termination after at least 1 valid score—and records evaluation, runtime, cost, format, context, permission, and other termination errors. The current public tree also preserves invalid runs: for example, GPT-4o Breakout run 0 has an empty agent result array while its trajectory file remains present. This supports a failure-retention claim, not an assertion that every possible error type is exhaustively released.

The public release has drifted beyond the paper experiment. At audited commit 9d40c1b5035202018cd7091fb4e83a9c68b377c0, the repository contains 676 .traj files and 676 paired results.json files, representing 13 model-directory names × 13 tasks × 4 runs. The additional gemini-20-pro grid is absent from the final 12-model paper analysis; no result from that grid is evidence for the paper's tables or conclusions.

The episode schema is directly inspectable in released files, including action, observation, response, state, thought, execution time, message history, cost/token statistics, exit status, submission, and intermediate/final scores. Task configs and evaluator code are also public. This supports analysis of behavior and feedback use, while the lack of a paper-bound 624-file manifest prevents exact record-to-table reconciliation.

The evidence does not validate training use. No policy optimizer, nonzero Gym reward adapter, trained checkpoint, or agent-training result is reported. Benchmark performance also cannot establish held-out validity because repeated validate exposes test-set scores, nor can it establish deterministic replay, uniform licensing, decontamination, privacy review, or scientific novelty.

最终论文在 13 个任务上评测 12 个模型，每个 model-task pair 运行 4 次，并用全部 624 条 trajectory 分析失败行为。在 aggregate AUP 比较中，Gemini-2.5-Pro 排名最高。除 o1-preview、Gemini-1.5-Pro 和 Gemini-2.0-Flash 外，每个模型都至少在 1 个任务上未能产生 valid submission。这些是作者报告的 benchmark 结果，尚未独立复现。

失败证据比 leaderboard score 更丰富。论文把 failure 定义为没有任何有效中间 test-set score，把 incompletion 定义为至少获得 1 个有效 score 后终止，并记录 evaluation、runtime、cost、format、context、permission 等终止错误。当前公开树也保留 invalid run；例如 GPT-4o Breakout run 0 的 agent 结果数组为空，但 trajectory 文件仍在。这支持“保留失败样本”的结论，但不代表所有可能错误类型都被完整发布。

公开 release 已超出论文实验范围。在审计 commit 9d40c1b5035202018cd7091fb4e83a9c68b377c0，仓库包含 676 个 .traj 文件和 676 个配对 results.json 文件，对应 13 个 model-directory name × 13 个任务 × 4 次运行。额外的 gemini-20-pro 网格不在最终论文的 12 模型分析中；该网格的任何结果都不能作为论文表格或结论的证据。

公开文件可直接检查 episode schema，包括 action、observation、response、state、thought、execution time、message history、cost/token 统计、exit status、submission 与中间/最终 score。Task config 与 evaluator code 也已公开。这些材料支持行为与反馈利用分析，但缺少与论文绑定的 624 文件 manifest，导致无法把每条记录精确对应到论文表格。

现有证据不能支持训练复用。论文没有报告 policy optimizer、非零 Gym reward adapter、trained checkpoint 或 agent-training result。由于反复 validate 会暴露 test-set score，benchmark 表现也不能证明 held-out validity，更不能证明确定性 replay、统一许可、decontamination、隐私审计或科学新意。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior benchmarks already combine language models with code execution, datasets, and automated metrics. MLE-Bench, MLAgentBench, RE-Bench, ScienceAgentBench, and SWE-Agent are the paper's relevant comparison surface. MLGym does not originate shell agents, public ML datasets, task-specific evaluators, or Gymnasium interfaces.

Its concrete change is to package 13 heterogeneous Level-1 research tasks behind one task-YAML, container, command, evaluator, and trajectory contract. The submitted artifact can vary by task, yet each run exposes a comparable lineage from prompt and environment state through thought/action/observation steps to validation history, submission, exit status, task metrics, and cross-task AUP.

The release adds content depth beyond final scores: full current-grid trajectories, both valid and invalid runs, evaluator/starter artifacts, and a replay helper are inspectable. This makes failure, cost, formatting, context exhaustion, evaluator interaction, and intermediate score-seeking behavior auditable. The later expansion from the paper's 624 analyzed runs to 676 public file pairs is release evolution, not paper novelty or extra experimental evidence.

The feedback design is directionally important but also the main caveat. Repeated validate turns the test metric into an interactive optimization signal. The environment therefore measures how well an agent can adapt to an exposed evaluator surface under budget, not performance under a once-only hidden final test. Likewise, a Gymnasium-compatible API does not imply an RL-ready reward because native reward is 0 and metrics live in info.score.

For reasoning-data research, the reusable idea is the explicit binding of task configuration, environment actions, observations, workspace state, flexible artifacts, evaluator histories, failures, and replay. Before treating the files as training data, one still needs a stable version, a non-leaky split protocol, a reward adapter and demonstrated objective, exact paper/current manifests, deterministic environment pins, and reconciled rights.

已有 benchmark 已经把语言模型与代码执行、dataset 和自动 metric 结合起来。MLE-Bench、MLAgentBench、RE-Bench、ScienceAgentBench 与 SWE-Agent 构成论文相关比较面。MLGym 没有发明 shell agent、公开 ML dataset、任务专属 evaluator 或 Gymnasium interface。

它的具体变化是把 13 个异构 Level-1 研究任务封装在统一的 task-YAML、container、command、evaluator 与 trajectory contract 后。submission artifact 可以因任务而异，但每条运行都呈现可比较的 lineage：从 prompt 和 environment state，经 thought/action/observation step，到 validation history、submission、exit status、task metric 与跨任务 AUP。

该 release 不只提供最终 score，还公开当前完整网格 trajectory、valid/invalid run、evaluator/starter artifact 和 replay helper，从而可以审计 failure、cost、formatting、context exhaustion、evaluator interaction 与寻找中间 score 的行为。公开文件从论文分析的 624 条扩展到当前 676 对，是 release 演进，不是论文 novelty 或额外实验依据。

feedback 设计具有方向意义，同时也是主要限制。反复 validate 把 test metric 变成交互式优化信号。因此，该环境衡量的是 agent 在预算内适应已暴露 evaluator surface 的能力，而不是一次性隐藏 final test 下的表现。同样，Gymnasium-compatible API 不代表 RL-ready reward，因为原生 reward 为 0，metric 位于 info.score。

对 reasoning-data 研究而言，可复用思想是显式绑定 task config、environment action、observation、workspace state、灵活 artifact、evaluator history、failure 与 replay。在把文件当作训练数据之前，仍需稳定版本、无泄漏 split protocol、reward adapter 与已展示 objective、精确的论文/当前 manifest、确定性环境固定信息以及统一权利审计。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The largest evaluation risk is unlimited visible test feedback. Appendix B explicitly allows repeated validate calls so the agent can improve on the test set, and Best Attempt selects the best valid intermediate score. This is online optimization against the scoring surface, not a once-only held-out test. Read-only evaluator files remain inspectable, enabling targeted optimization of implementation details or blind spots.

Feedback semantics are easy to misstate. MLGymEnv.step currently returns reward 0 on every transition, while task metrics are stored in info.score. An RL system that consumes the native reward without an adapter would receive no task signal. Heterogeneous metrics and AUP additionally depend on direction conversion, infeasible-run treatment, task mixture, and best-of-4 selection.

Validity and quality are different. A valid run requires at least 1 evaluator score; it need not beat the baseline, generalize, or discover anything scientifically new. Failed and incomplete runs are retained, which is valuable for audit, but post-paper additions, corrections, deletions, and error-to-file mappings lack a stable release ledger. The exact mapping from the final paper's 624 runs to the current 676 file pairs is unavailable.

Replay is partial. run_replay.py can reissue recorded assistant actions, but current documentation uses aigym/mlgym-agent:latest; the repository has 0 tags, 0 GitHub releases, and a changelog containing only a heading. No paper-run OCI digest, complete data/task/evaluator/dependency/GPU manifest, checksum set, or end-to-end deterministic replay result is published. Mutable upstream datasets and hardware behavior can change scores even when actions are identical.

There is no benchmark-wide clean task split or decontamination audit. Constituent datasets use task-specific splits, yet repeated test-score exposure defeats a clean final holdout. Public tasks, baselines, evaluator code, and trajectories also create future model-training and benchmark-leakage surfaces; pretraining exposure and instance-level overlap are undisclosed.

Licensing is mixed. The README assigns most code CC BY-NC 4.0, SWE-Agent and Modded-NanoGPT portions MIT, and Gymnax/Gymnax-blines portions Apache-2.0. These notices do not provide one license for every upstream dataset, generated trajectory, submission, model output, or dependency; blanket commercial reuse is unsupported. No benchmark-wide PII, consent, deletion, or takedown audit is reported.

Security controls are incomplete. Agents run broad shell and training commands in a non-root container, with evaluator/data protected by normal read-only permissions, but paper-run policies for network access, package installation, secrets, malicious upstream artifacts, container capabilities, and GPU isolation are not fully specified.

最大的评测风险是无限次可见 test feedback。Appendix B 明确允许反复调用 validate，使 agent 能在 test set 上继续改进；Best Attempt 又选择最好的有效中间 score。这是针对评分面的在线优化，而不是一次性 held-out test。evaluator 文件虽然 read-only，但仍可阅读，agent 可以针对实现细节或 blind spot 定向优化。

feedback 语义很容易被误述。当前 MLGymEnv.step 在每个 transition 都返回 reward 0，任务 metric 则存入 info.score。若 RL 系统直接消费 native reward 而没有 adapter，就得不到任务信号。异构 metric 与 AUP 还依赖方向转换、infeasible-run 处理、任务混合和 best-of-4 选择。

validity 不等于质量。valid run 只要求至少产生 1 个 evaluator score，不必超过 baseline、具备泛化或发现科学新意。保留 failed 与 incomplete run 对审计有价值，但 post-paper 新增、修正、删除以及 error-to-file mapping 缺少稳定 release ledger。最终论文 624 条运行到当前 676 对文件的精确映射不可获得。

replay 仅部分成立。run_replay.py 可以重新发出记录的 assistant action，但当前文档使用 aigym/mlgym-agent:latest；仓库有 0 个 tag、0 个 GitHub release，changelog 只有标题。官方没有发布 paper-run OCI digest、完整 data/task/evaluator/dependency/GPU manifest、checksum 集或端到端确定性 replay 结果。即使 action 相同，可变上游 dataset 与 hardware 行为仍可能改变 score。

系统没有 benchmark-wide 干净 task split 或 decontamination audit。组成 dataset 使用各自的 task-specific split，但反复暴露 test score 破坏了干净 final holdout。公开 task、baseline、evaluator code 与 trajectory 也形成未来模型训练和 benchmark 泄漏面；pretraining exposure 与 instance-level overlap 未披露。

许可是混合的。README 将多数代码设为 CC BY-NC 4.0，SWE-Agent 与 Modded-NanoGPT 部分为 MIT，Gymnax/Gymnax-blines 部分为 Apache-2.0。这些声明没有为每个上游 dataset、生成 trajectory、submission、model output 或 dependency 提供统一许可；不支持无条件商业复用。论文未报告 benchmark-wide PII、consent、deletion 或 takedown 审计。

安全控制也不完整。agent 在非 root container 中执行广泛 shell 与训练命令，evaluator/data 通过常规 read-only 权限保护，但论文运行的 network access、package installation、secret、恶意上游 artifact、container capability 与 GPU isolation policy 未完整说明。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the environment-agent-trajectory track, MLGym is a strong schema reference. A reusable episode should preserve task and dataset IDs, config and evaluator revisions, container digest, reset state, prompt/history, step index, thought, parsed action, observation, workspace state, execution time, validation calls and scores, submission, exit status, cost/tokens, model configuration, seed, and upstream licenses. The published .traj format covers many behavioral fields but not every immutable replay dependency.

The 676 current trajectory/result pairs support evaluation and audit studies: compare valid, failed, and incomplete runs; analyze action or error sequences; measure adaptation after score feedback; inspect cost/context/permission terminations; and test replay sensitivity across pinned environments. The final-paper 624 subset must be identified separately, and the post-paper gemini-20-pro grid must remain outside paper-result comparisons.

A defensible benchmark extension would separate development feedback from a hidden final test, cap or log validation queries, keep evaluators inaccessible during the final phase, report score trajectories rather than only best observed values, and audit evaluator robustness. These are proposed reuse checks, not features already demonstrated by MLGym.

The environment can also serve as an engineering substrate for future agent training, but current evidence supports only evaluation and audit. Before RL use, implement and document how info.score becomes a nonzero reward, normalize heterogeneous metric directions, define credit assignment, prevent test leakage, and publish the optimizer, rollout selection, checkpoint, and training results. Before SFT use, define trajectory filters and rights for model thoughts, commands, outputs, and source data.

Reuse class: safe as a reading, evaluation-design, failure-analysis, and release-audit reference. Public code and trajectory files may be studied under their component terms, but blanket training or commercial reuse is blocked by mixed licenses, exposed test feedback, mutable versioning, incomplete replay pins, and absent training evidence.

对 environment-agent-trajectory track 而言，MLGym 是很强的 schema 参考。可复用 episode 应保留 task/dataset ID、config/evaluator revision、container digest、reset state、prompt/history、step index、thought、parsed action、observation、workspace state、execution time、validation call 与 score、submission、exit status、cost/token、模型配置、seed 和上游 license。公开 .traj 格式覆盖了许多行为字段，但没有覆盖全部不可变 replay dependency。

当前 676 对 trajectory/result 文件可用于 evaluation 与 audit：比较 valid、failed、incomplete run，分析 action/error sequence，衡量 score feedback 后的适应，检查 cost/context/permission termination，并在固定环境间测试 replay 敏感性。最终论文的 624 子集必须单独识别，post-paper gemini-20-pro 网格必须排除在论文结果比较之外。

更严谨的 benchmark extension 应把 development feedback 与隐藏 final test 分开，限制或记录 validation query，在 final phase 隐藏 evaluator，报告 score trajectory 而不只报告最佳观测值，并审计 evaluator robustness。这些是建议的复用检查，不是 MLGym 已经展示的功能。

该环境也可作为未来 agent training 的工程底座，但当前证据只支持 evaluation 与 audit。用于 RL 前，应实现并说明如何把 info.score 转换为非零 reward、统一异构 metric 方向、定义 credit assignment、防止 test leakage，并发布 optimizer、rollout selection、checkpoint 与训练结果。用于 SFT 前，应定义 trajectory filter，以及 model thought、command、output 与源数据的权利边界。

复用等级：可安全作为阅读、评测设计、失败分析与 release audit 参考。公开代码和 trajectory 文件可在各组件条款下研究，但混合许可、暴露 test feedback、可变版本、不完整 replay 固定信息与缺少训练证据，阻止无条件训练或商业复用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Start with Sections 4.1–4.5 and Appendix D to reconstruct task configuration, the single-command loop, validate/submit, container state, and trajectory fields.
  • Keep the feedback boundary explicit: evaluator metrics are stored in info.score, while current native Gym reward is 0 at every transition.
  • Do not merge counts: the final paper analyzes 624 trajectories from 12 models × 13 tasks × 4 seeds; audited public main contains 676 file pairs and an extra post-paper model grid.
  • Read Appendix B and the Best Attempt definition together; unlimited visible test-set validation is an adaptive optimization channel, not a clean held-out protocol.
  • Verify next a tagged manifest, 624-to-676 file mapping, OCI digests, replay determinism, split/decontamination controls, and source-by-source license/privacy/security terms.

• 先读 Sections 4.1–4.5 与 Appendix D，重建 task config、single-command loop、validate/submit、container state 与 trajectory field。
  • 明确 feedback 边界：evaluator metric 存在 info.score，当前原生 Gym reward 在每个 transition 都是 0。
  • 不要合并数字：最终论文分析 12 个模型 × 13 个任务 × 4 个 seed = 624 条 trajectory；审计时 public main 有 676 对文件和一个 post-paper 额外模型网格。
  • 将 Appendix B 与 Best Attempt 定义一起阅读；无限次可见 test-set validation 是自适应优化通道，不是干净 held-out protocol。
  • 后续核验 tagged manifest、624 到 676 的文件映射、OCI digest、replay 确定性、split/decontamination 控制，以及逐来源 license/privacy/security 条款。
